items.title: The closure of a submodule is the intersection of its translates of the open submodules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a linearly topologized module M over a topological ring R with a fundamental system of open submodules M_lambda and a submodule N, the lemma computes the closure of N as the intersection of the N + M_lambda (statement lines 921-927). The proof is displayed in both directions: each N + M_lambda is open hence closed, so the intersection is closed; and if x is not in the closure of N then some x + M_lambda misses N entirely, whence x is not in N + M_lambda (proof lines 929-933). The level is H2: a short but complete elementary argument, with the open-and-closed observation and the point-avoidance argument both written out.
